title: Breast augmentation
what: The surgeon places implants under the breast tissue or under the chest muscle. The breasts become larger and change shape.
why: When you are unhappy with the size or shape of your breasts, after breastfeeding, weight loss, or by nature.
duration: surgery usually takes 1 to 2 hours; you usually stay at the clinic until the next day
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to stop and when
Allergies to medicines, latex, or iodine
If you plan a pregnancy and breastfeeding
Breast lumps, or breast cancer in the family

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and a breast ultrasound or mammogram. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthetist
prepare.text: Before surgery, an anesthetist will talk with you. Tell them about your health and medicines.

prepare.title: Food and water
prepare.text: Usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Bra
prepare.text: A special support bra is usually needed. It is fitted in advance.

steps: The surgeon marks your breasts while you stand
A cut is made in the crease under the breast, at the areola, or in the armpit
A pocket is made, and the implant is placed
A support garment is put on
feel: Tightness and pressure in the chest, especially if the implant is under the muscle
Pain for the first days. You will get painkillers
Temporary numbness or extra sensitivity of the nipples
after: The support bra is usually worn for a few weeks
Do not raise your arms high or carry heavy things. Your doctor will say for how long
Sleep on your back at first
Implants are checked from time to time. Your surgeon will give you a schedule
red_flags: One breast quickly gets bigger, tight, and blue
A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), redness, or pus
Sudden shortness of breath or chest pain: call emergency services

faq.a: Often yes. Discuss it with your surgeon in advance.

faq.q: Do implants need to be replaced?
faq.a: Not on a fixed schedule, but if problems appear. Regular checkups help spot them in time.

reminders.text: Surgery tomorrow. Bring your support bra and button-up clothes. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
